description: Fires strongly when the opponent has three stacked on top of column 0 with the cell above empty (I must block in column 0), whether or not they just played there; also on other opponent must-blocks in column 0 (e.g. diagonal, weaker; horizontal row-0 threats do not count). Weaker firing when the opponent just dropped the third stone into column 0 mid/late game. Not my own column-0 three, nor stacks in other columns.
effect: Raises the probability of playing column 0 (block on top of column 0): forcing it high moved column 0 from 0.00 to 0.35 in a neutral opening and from 0.72 to 0.99 in a mid-game position; zeroing it cut column 0 from 0.72 to 0.47. Where a vertical block is forced the move is already 1.00 col 0 and unchanged.
notes: Top of distribution (act>15) is almost exclusively the opponent's vertical three in column 0 (program precision 0.97 for that rule, but only 27% recall). The remaining firing (act 2-8) is a graded column-0 signal (col0 height 2-3, threats near (3,0)/(4,0), opponent just played col0) that continues below threshold; no sharp rule found. Best dev F1 0.448 (P .43 R .46, AUROC .72), simulation share 0.82. 7 of 8 score calls used (first one accidentally duplicated).
